summary: Virtual staging for listing photos: six watermarked photos free once, then monthly plans or a one-time 30-photo pack. The official page labels these as launch prices.

pricing.details: Official launch prices. 6 staged photos once, free, with a light watermark. Base 8 €/month (10 photos) or 80 €/year (120); Standard 35 €/month (45) or 348 €/year (540); Professional 70 €/month (100) or 704 €/year (1,200); one-time Listing pack 26 € for 30 photos, no renewal. Unused photos roll over on paid plans; cancel anytime.
